verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Sprinto manages several frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) in one place and uses 'pre-mapped controls'. It never documents controls or evidence mapping across frameworks, SOC 2 work automatically counting toward ISO 27001 or HIPAA, or any view of the overlap. Multi-framework support is an adjacent capability, not cross-framework mapping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown
